tactics.label: body_image_pressure
tactics.reason: The title promises losing 10 pounds in just 3 days, pushing viewers to chase quick results.

reality_check: This video claims you can lose 10 pounds in 3 days, but the creator only lost 6 pounds. It is built to make you feel like quick weight loss is easy. If it got to you, that is the video working, not something wrong with you.
